Question ID: MAR_U02_L06_GP_Q01
MLA Standard: MLA.MAR.CHEM.02

Guided practice item 1.
Lesson focus: Nutrients, Dissolved Gases, pH, and Water Quality
Stimulus: Water-quality data stimulus

A student reviews the assigned marine evidence and must explain the first clear pattern. Which answer uses the marine evidence most accurately?

generalfeedback.text: Teachable feedback: First, Identify the physical or chemical variable. Then use the required stimulus (Water-quality data stimulus) to connect the visible evidence to physical and chemical ocean conditions shown by models, graphs, and data. Correct reasoning stays inside MLA.MAR.CHEM.02 and avoids this common mistake: describing ocean conditions without connecting the data to depth, motion, density, chemistry, or climate.
